mapper.select:
SELECT c.community_id, c.community_code, c.community_name, c.address_line, c.longitude, c.latitude, c.location_source, c.coordinate_system, c.amap_poi_id, c.location_verified_at, c.completion_year, c.status, c.version, c.created_at, c.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM building b WHERE b.community_id = c.community_id) AS building_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM property_unit p JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = p.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE b.community_id = c.community_id) AS property_count FROM community c
(c.community_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.community_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.address_line LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND c.status = #{status}
AND c.community_id IN #{scopeId} AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY c.community_name, c.community_id

SELECT c.community_id, c.community_code, c.community_name, c.address_line, c.longitude, c.latitude, c.location_source, c.coordinate_system, c.amap_poi_id, c.location_verified_at, c.completion_year, c.status, c.version, c.created_at, c.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM building b WHERE b.community_id = c.community_id) AS building_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM property_unit p JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id=p.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id=bu.building_id WHERE b.community_id=c.community_id) AS property_count FROM community c WHERE c.community_id = #{communityId} AND c.community_id IN #{scopeId} AND 1 = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community (community_code, community_name, address_line, longitude, latitude, completion_year, status) VALUES (#{entity.communityCode}, #{entity.communityName}, #{entity.addressLine}, #{entity.longitude}, #{entity.latitude}, #{entity.completionYear}, COALESCE(#{entity.status}, 'ACTIVE'))
mapper.update: UPDATE community SET community_name=#{entity.communityName}, address_line=#{entity.addressLine}, longitude=#{entity.longitude}, latitude=#{entity.latitude}, completion_year=#{entity.completionYear}, status=COALESCE(#{entity.status},status), version=version+1 WHERE community_id=#{communityId} AND version=#{entity.version}
